sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Sew it Good - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Barev! I haven't seen such a decicated dude like you in a long time. Seriously, brother, I'm not joking!\n\nThis time I need a Trooper plate carrier and a Gzhel armor. You've heard of those, right? Popular items. The condition doesn't matter, I'll put everything to good use. And I promised I'd tell you why I need all this. I was thinking it'd be great to start making my own stuff. I've already found a few good tailors, and they're studying the samples right now. But not a word to anyone, got it? I don't want competitors trying to copy me."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Obtain 2 HighCom Trooper TFO body armor (MultiCam)
- Hand over the items
- Obtain 2 BNTI Gzhel-K body armor
- Hand over the items

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Oakley Mechanism heavy duty backpack (Black)
- Unlocks craft for Ars Arma A18 Skanda plate carrier (MultiCam) at Lavatory level 2
"Found them? Great! Here, this is for you."
